title: codemother's question file becomes her delegated share of the librarian's corpus
intention: CodeMother's cognition_questions.json becomes her delegated share of the librarian's cross-domain questions: it names the ids she holds and keeps only her own coding-domain questions, and her seed reads the held questions' words from the librarian.
why: Measured 2026-11-05: cairn/devices/codemother/cognition_questions.json holds 13 of UU's 18 verbatim Q-cog questions (014..018 lost) and 11 Gemini-worded questions under a provenance that reads as Akien verbatim. Akien 2026-11-05 (open-6f41eecaf09d): 'if a device owns a question, it's also kind of a delegate, because all knowledge belongs ultimately to the librarian.' Outline 4.3.1.11.1, 4.3.1.11.6.
how: cairn/devices/codemother/cognition_questions.json: the cognition_questions and novelty_matrix sections go; a new 'holds' list names the librarian corpus ids she holds (all 18 Q-cog-001..018, Q-nov-001..014, so Q-cog-014..018 come back), and a 'delegated_from' field names cairn/devices/librarian/cross_domain_questions.json; coding_domain (Q-code-*) stays, hers, unchanged. cairn/devices/codemother/seed_trees.py: the sections list is built from cairn.devices.librarian.cross_domain_questions.load() (the librarian's public interface, ticket 2248911aaf05) for every held id, plus coding_domain from her file; each held question's provenance gains origin (verbatim|proposed) from the corpus; a held id the corpus does not carry is an error, loud, not skipped. How and where seed deposits is unchanged (ticket 2b3d842bc118 owns that). Depends on 2248911aaf05.
falsifier: (1) cognition_questions.json carries no question text for any id in the librarian's corpus, and no cognition_questions or novelty_matrix key; (2) every id in its holds list resolves in cross_domain_questions.load(), and holds includes Q-cog-014..018; (3) seed(dry_run=True) returns one entry per held id plus one per coding_domain question, each held entry's content starting with the librarian corpus's text for that id; (4) seed(dry_run=True) with a holds list naming an id the corpus lacks reports it in errors and exits non-zero from the CLI; (5) seed_trees.py reaches the corpus only through cairn.devices.librarian.cross_domain_questions (no path to the librarian's json file in its source); (6) every held entry's provenance carries the corpus origin.

decisions.text: D1 (the /sorted builder_check): A Haiku builder needs, and the how carries: which keys go, the holds list contents, the delegated_from value, the exact import to use, that a missing id is an error not a skip, that the deposit path is untouched, and the proof path with one tooth per clause.
